The mixer shall be run for a minimum period of 2 minutes after all materials are loaded in full quantity.
When the temperature is above (32 deg. C.), reduce the mixing/delivery time from 11/2 hrs. to 1-1/4 hrs.
Concrete shall be thoroughly compacted, as depositing shall proceed by means of suitable vibrators.
For the next 7 days the surface shall be kept wet all the time by sprinkling water continuously.
The slump shall be 25 mm to 35 mm depending upon the location and type of Work.
The PH value of water shall not be less than 6 and more than 9.
